document.title: Right to Free, Universal, Scientific and Research-Oriented Education Bill Legal Provenance Ledger

claims.text: Article 21A guarantees free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 years.
claims.limitations: Does not cover pre-primary (3-6 yrs) or higher/vocational education (14-22 yrs).

claims.text: Article 51A(h) casts a fundamental duty on citizens to develop scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
claims.limitations: Directive duty requiring statutory curricular implementation.
claims.reviewer_action: Verified against Part IVA of Constitution.

claims.text: The Supreme Court ruled in Unni Krishnan (1993) that education cannot be commercialized and capitation fees are unlawful.

authorities.title: Unni Krishnan, J.P. v. State of Andhra Pradesh

claims.subsequent_history_checked: Affirmed in TMA Pai (2002) and Islamic Academy (2003).
claims.limitations: Enforcement requires state-level fee regulation commissions and criminal sanctions.
